title: Chapter 4: The Cloud DBA Role: What Changes, What Stays

questions.q: The chapter says the IAM database authentication token is the conceptual analog of:
options: A SQL Server login password stored in Secrets Manager
Windows Firewall rules for port 1433
Kerberos authentication with Active Directory — a time-limited credential from a central authority
A database-scoped configuration setting
questions.explain: The chapter draws the explicit analog: the application proves its identity to a central authority (IAM) and receives a time-limited credential, just like Kerberos with Active Directory.

questions.q: Which of the following is true about RDS for SQL Server configuration limits in the chapter?
options: True sysadmin access does not exist on RDS; the master user is a functional substitute without OS-level access
You can disable TLS encryption on RDS connections
You can run your own transaction log backup chain on the instance
SQL Server Agent, SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS are all fully available
questions.explain: The chapter lists what you cannot configure on RDS: TLS is forced on, log backup scheduling is AWS-managed, components like Agent/SSIS/SSAS/SSRS are unavailable, and true sysadmin does not exist.

questions.q: Performance Insights retention is described as:
options: 30 days free with no paid extension
Unlimited by default
Real-time only with no history
7 days free by default, extendable up to 2 years with the paid tier
questions.explain: The chapter states Performance Insights has 7 days of retention free and can be extended up to 2 years with an additional per-vCPU-hour charge.

questions.q: In Azure SQL Database, Entra-backed contained users are created with:
options: sp_addlogin followed by sp_adduser
CREATE USER [name] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER — with no password
CREATE LOGIN with a certificate
Active Directory group policy objects
questions.explain: The chapter shows Entra-backed contained users created via CREATE USER [dba-engineer@company.com] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER, with no password involved.

questions.q: The chapter advises operations DBAs to develop skills in which three areas?
options: C# development, Kubernetes administration, and data science
Infrastructure as Code fluency, observability and alerting design, and database migration engineering
Hardware procurement, SAN zoning, and tape backup management
Only T-SQL query tuning and index maintenance
questions.explain: The chapter's practical advice names three skill areas: IaC fluency (Terraform/Pulumi), observability and alerting design, and database migration engineering.
